services.name: Public Cruise
services.desc: Welcome aboard Minnesota’s award-winning cruises! Align your product, clients, and staff with the award-winning cruise professionals at Al and Alma’s. Since the early 1970’s, world-class businesses and their leaders have trusted the team at Al and Alma’s to deliver an unrivaled Lake Minnetonka cruise experience. Our team of professional event planners will partner with you to create custom private cruise details, including departure and return times, custom menus with delicious options, budget specific pricing, cruise enhancements like live entertainment, wine and beer tasting and more. Begin your day with a dockside meeting and toast to your success with a custom designed sunset cruise.

blurb: Guests board luxury yachts for private or public cruises on Lake Minnetonka featuring buffet dining, scenic views, and customizable event options. Cruises include meals, dessert, and sales tax; beverages and gratuities are additional. The fleet offers various yachts suitable for weddings, corporate events, and celebrations with professional event planning and onboard service.
